dict.Cursul îl iei de pe site-ul BNR, din ziu: Take the rate from the central bank website, for the invoice date and the payment date; if payment is made in several instalments, enter each instalment on its own row.
dict.Facturi deschise (neîncasate sau neplăti: Open invoices (not yet collected or paid)
dict.Facturi în valută și diferențe de curs: Foreign currency invoices and exchange differences
dict.Facturile deschise se reevaluează la sfâ: Open invoices are revalued at the end of the month at the central bank rate; check with your accountant which rate is used for VAT and revaluation.
dict.Facturile emise sau primite în euro ori: Invoices issued or received in euro or another currency: from the rate at the invoice and at the payment you get the value in lei and the exchange difference: gain (green) or loss (red), depending on the type of invoice; invoices still open show in yellow, with their value and the net result.
dict.La o factură emisă, un curs mai mare la: On an issued invoice, a higher rate at collection is a gain; on a received invoice, a higher rate at payment is a loss.
dict.Valoarea deschisă, în lei la cursul fact: Open value, in lei at the invoice rate
dict.Factura: nr. din\nPartenerul:\nValoarea::

At payment or collection:
☐ bank statement with the amount received or paid, in currency
☐ rate on the payment date entered in the table: the exchange difference shows
☐ if paid in instalments: each instalment on its own row

At the end of the month:
☐ invoices still open handed to the accountant, for revaluation at the central bank rate
☐ the month's exchange differences checked with the accountant (“Summary”: gains, losses, net result)
